text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the spring Tenno Sho draws near, Tokai Teio throws herself more and more into training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How'd I do? Did I get a faster time?!
choice_data_list: You're guaranteed to win at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heck yeah! You just wait—I'll prove I can dominate in senior year too!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha, you seem hard at work.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah! Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The Tenno Sho is almost here. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling amazing, of course!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I've made it all the way to senior year now, so I can't go messing up at this point!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah… Bold as brass, and working hard to achieve your goals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With your classic year over, I look forward to seeing what kind of performance you'll show us next.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Then don't be shocked when I blow your expectations out of the water!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Huh? What's with the crowd?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My apologies, but I'm in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: All we need is a quick comment on your upcoming Tenno Sho challenge!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: At least tell us how you're feeling!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I would be happy to during a press conference, but for now I must take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must push myself even harder!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Aah?! Miss McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: A group of reporters, it seems… They really should know better than to meddle in a racer's training.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: She could've just answered a few questions…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well… there was a time when she would have readily indulged them for such a simple affair.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, however, that is not the case. There has been a monumental shift inside her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Take note, Teio. When you face her on the track, victory will not come easily.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Really? I mean, sure, I know she's a tough opponent and all…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I'm training just as hard as she is! We're both giving it our all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: In fact, lemme show you right now just how powerful I've become!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Just as hard," huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Several days later…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A press conference is held for the spring Tenno Sho participants.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Though you're in your senior year now, there's a lot at stake in this race. How do you feel?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I feel like a winner already! My legend is gonna continue through my senior year!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen is a competitor you'll need to look out for. What are your thoughts on her?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm not the least bit worried! I feel like I'm the strongest I've ever been!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter who I'm up against, I'm not gonna lose! I could run to the ends of the earth!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Oh! You seem to be brimming with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next up is Mejiro McQueen's interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling about the Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I am putting everything I have into avoiding unsatisfactory results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I must win… and I'm prepared to do whatever it takes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You seem to be going all out in your training. Do you feel like you have a handle on it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I sense that this is the best condition I could hope for.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I'm stronger than I've ever been before… I feel as if I could race to the heavens themselves.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heeey! Don't be such a copycat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wh-what do you think you're doing?! This is my interview!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: How're you gonna win if you aim for the heavens, anyway?! You'd just smash straight into the ceiling of the starting gate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's just an expression! I'm not actually going there!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Well, this is a surprise! We're already seeing sparks fly between this year's biggest competitors!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: This year's spring Tenno Sho is going to be quite the show!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ugh… So much for this interview.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're the one who started it by copying me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In any case, I'm different than who I was before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: They will all see my ascension. From the earth to the heavens above…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: From the earth?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reporters seem excited to see these two clash before the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their showdown at the spring Tenno Sho is fast approaching!
